answer: Price each identity as a vertex in a trust graph whose standing rises only when several already-established peers from separate funding clusters co-sign audited work-receipts, each endorsement inked like a quill stroke onto a non-transferable bond sealed in a vault that vests solely after many distinct-cluster signatures accrue. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one funding root, so every endorsement folds back to a single cluster and the bond never vests; the farm must age and fund a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head, cost linear per clone, while an honest agent pays once.
